breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to treat the internal torque as uniform. Instead, it performed the correct piecewise analysis, calculating a different internal torque for each segment of the shaft (T_internal_1 = 150000 N·mm and T_internal_2 = 300000 N·mm). This aligns perfectly with the ground truth, which removed the incorrect instruction.
